script.problem: The one line is more than one sentence.

terra.problem: The first moment includes David’s promises to Mephibosheth, which are made after Mephibosheth leaves Lo-debar and comes to David, not at Lo-debar.
The second moment happens at Mahanaim, not Lo-debar. Machir is from Lo-debar, but he meets and helps David at Mahanaim.
